comments.regular: [Verified] bUseBlurShader is the INI setting "bUseBlurShader:BlurShader". Startup uses this boolean with bDoImageSpaceEffect to decide whether the separate Bloom lighting mode (+0x1DA) is active when HDR mode is off.
